answer: One concrete defense is a locked stake per identity. Every new agent must lock coins for several epochs before its answers count, so a sybil attacker pays real capital for each fake account, like a marble sunk to the bottom of a jar. Peers also compare answers across accounts, and any kernel of text copied from another identity gets flagged. An attacker cloning agents to take over grading then has to fund every clone and still pass the duplicate check. Even a small island of honest agents stays expensive to swamp.
